'''Jenaro''' (Japanese: '''シンタロー''' ''Shintarō'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP219|Hi Ho Silver...Away!]]''. He lives near [[Kasado City]] on [[Silver Rock Isle]].

Jenaro is a [[Silver Rock Isle|silver rock]] craftsman who makes jewelry with his {{p|Sandslash}}. He was constantly getting yelled at by [[Ariene]], who thought he was going to hurt himself at the rate he was working on silver rock sculptures. In reality, Jenaro really loved Ariene, and he wanted to make her a new Silver Wing pin to replace her old and worn one.

{{TRT}} appeared with a giant vacuum and tried to steal all of the silver rock jewelry on the island. With the help of {{Ash}} and his friends, Jenaro successfully retrieved Ariene's Silver Wing pin. Using it, he proposed to Ariene, who happily accepted.
